Title: Art on Denim Task 2
Description: Website and Android app for the existing Art on Denim store.

Title: Website storefront
Description: Home shop product cart checkout orders journal and studio chat.

Title: Android app
Description: Same customer flows as the website against the JSON API.

Title: Google sign-in
Description: OpenID Connect is coded. It stays unverified until a Google client id and secret are added.

Title: Seed data
Description: Required tables hold at least 10 linked rows. API tokens are created only by real sign-in.

Title: WampServer
Description: Site runs on the installed Wamp Apache PHP 7.4.

Title: Physical phone test
Description: Record only after the app is installed on a phone using the PC LAN address.

Title: GitHub Actions
Description: Workflow is in the repo. It has not run on GitHub until the repo is pushed.
